name: presentaciones-revealjs
description: Repositorio central de presentaciones interactivas usando reveal.js

scripts.copy-reveal: mkdir -p vendor/reveal && cp -r node_modules/reveal.js/dist vendor/reveal/ && mkdir -p vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/notes vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/markdown vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/search vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/zoom vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/math && cp vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/notes.js vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/notes/notes.js && cp vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/markdown.js vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/markdown/markdown.js && cp vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/highlight.js vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/highlight/highlight.js && cp vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/search.js vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/search/search.js && cp vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/zoom.js vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/zoom/zoom.js && cp vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/math.js vendor/reveal/dist/plugin/math/math.js
scripts.postinstall: npm run scan && npm run copy-reveal
